# BJS — Louisiana Incarceration Profile (prison, jail, probation, parole)

- **Produced:** 2026-10-18 · **Pack:** REQ-20261018-4436 (BJS incarceration pack for Karl)
- **Sources:** Bureau of Justice Statistics — *Prisoners in 2023 – Statistical Tables* (NCJ 310197, Sep 2025); *Jail Inmates in 2024 – Statistical Tables* (NCJ 311504, Sep 2026); *Probation and Parole in the United States, 2024* (NCJ 311290, Apr 2026)
- **As-of:** prison yearend 2023 · jail midyear 2024 · community supervision yearend 2024 (latest published per series at pull time)
- **Legal basis:** U.S. Government public domain (BJS published statistical tables)
- **Raw landing:** `pf-raw-lake` `raw/bjs_incarceration/v20261018/` (p23st.zip, ji24st.zip, ppus24.zip + full-report PDFs)
- **Method note:** every figure below is transcribed from the named published table; no figure is computed by this pack.

## Prison — Louisiana jurisdiction (Prisoners in 2023)

- **28,186 persons** were under Louisiana correctional jurisdiction at yearend 2023 — 26,618 male and 1,568 female — up 3.3% from 27,296 at yearend 2022 (Table 2, p23stt02.csv).
- By race or Hispanic origin at yearend 2023: **White 9,879; Black 18,186** (Appendix Table 1, p23stat01.csv) — Black Louisianans were about two-thirds of the state's prison jurisdiction population, as published.
- Louisiana's imprisonment rate was **617 sentenced prisoners per 100,000 residents** in 2023 (596 in 2022), against a U.S. rate of 360 (Table 7, p23stt07.csv; U.S. rate from the report finding).
- Sentenced admissions to Louisiana jurisdiction in 2023: **14,395**, up 1.6% from 14,175 in 2022 (Table 8, p23stt08.csv).
- **Parish-jail housing is structural in Louisiana:** 14,850 prisoners under state jurisdiction were held in local jails at yearend 2023 — **52.7% of the state's custody population**, the published share (Table 14, p23stt14.csv). Louisiana held 0 prisoners in private prisons in 2023 (Table 14).
- Most serious offense mix of Louisiana state custody (Table 18, p23stt18.csv): violent 56.5%, property 12.9%, drug 13.5%, public-order 16.6%.
- State facility capacity at yearend 2023: rated capacity 17,956 with 13,336 persons in state-facility custody (Table 21, p23stt21.csv) — the balance of the jurisdiction population sits in local jails (Table 14).

## Jail — Louisiana, midyear 2024 (Jail Inmates in 2024)

- Confined population at midyear 2024: **30,789**; average daily population **30,126**; annual admissions **196,748** (Table 2, ji24stt02.csv).
- Louisiana's jail incarceration rate was **670 per 100,000 residents** — against a U.S. rate of 194 (Table 2; U.S. total row). Louisiana's published rate is the state-table outlier: more than three times the national rate, as published.

## Community supervision — Louisiana, yearend 2024 (Probation and Parole in the United States, 2024)

- **54,000 adults** under community supervision at December 31, 2024 (53,400 at January 1, 2024) — **1,532 per 100,000 adult residents**, above the U.S. rate of 1,372 (Appendix Table 5, ppus24at05.xlsx).
- Probation: **37,220** at yearend 2024 (1,056 per 100,000 adults), up 1.4% during 2024 (Appendix Table 6, ppus24at06.xlsx) — of which felony probation **28,530** (Appendix Table 7, ppus24at07.xlsx) and misdemeanor probation **8,690** (Appendix Table 8, ppus24at08.xlsx).
- Parole: **18,240** at yearend 2024 (517 per 100,000 adults), up 1.4% during 2024 (Appendix Table 11, ppus24at11.xlsx).

# Hospital Price Transparency — Banked Coverage Note (Louisiana)

**Provenance:** This note is built ONLY from banked receipts for the N7 lane (dataset `provider_list_prices` — hospital machine-readable standard-charges files published by hospitals under the CMS Hospital Price Transparency rule, 45 CFR Part 180). Counted from an R2 census of the raw landing prefix on 2026-10-18 ~22:35Z. It does not open or parse the price files themselves.

**As-of:** 2026-10-18 ~22:35Z census. The N7 retry lane was still RUNNING at census time; coverage below is a mid-lane snapshot, not a final count.

## What is banked so far

- **39 hospital price files, 6,899,285,532 bytes (~6.9 GB)**, landed under `raw/provider_list_prices/v20261016/files/` in pf-raw-lake, most recent file landed 2026-10-18 21:31Z.
- Every file is a **Louisiana** facility's published standard-charges file (CSV, JSON, or ZIP of the same), named by facility + EIN slug. Systems represented in the banked set include Ochsner (incl. Ochsner LSU Health Shreveport, Lafayette General, Abrom Kaplan, Acadia General, American Legion, St. Martin, St. Mary/Morgan City, specialty and behavioral-health sites), CHRISTUS (Coushatta, St. Frances Cabrini, Shreveport-Bossier Highland, Lake Area, St. Patrick, Louisiana Surgical Hospital), Oceans Behavioral Health (9 sites), North Oaks (medical center + rehabilitation), Baton Rouge General (Ascension ZIP), Encompass Health Rehabilitation (Alexandria, Shreveport), Rapides Regional Medical Center, Woman's Hospital, St. Bernard Parish Hospital, St. Charles Parish Hospital, and Louisiana Behavioral Health.
- File sizes span roughly 0.2 MB to several hundred MB per facility — the large files are full chargemaster-scale price lists (every shoppable + non-shoppable item with gross charge, discounted cash price, and payer-specific negotiated rates as each hospital publishes them).

## Status and caveats

- **Lane manifest not yet published:** as of the census, `chain/provider_list_prices/` held no stage0 manifest in either R2 bucket — per house rule the manifest is written LAST when the N7 lane closes, so treat the 39-file / 6.9 GB figure as verified raw-bank state, not a closed manifest total. The lane's remaining files (the N7 target set is Louisiana hospitals statewide) land under the same prefix as the retry completes.
- **Companion hospital data now banked (this REQ):** the CMS HCRIS cost-report extracts (`cms_hcris`, FY2011–2024, all US + 202 Louisiana hospitals in FY2024) landed alongside this note give the cost side of the same facilities — HCRIS total costs and cost-to-charge ratios join to these price files by facility name/CCN for cost-vs-charge comparisons.
- **Ownership joins:** `cms_ownership` (banked 2026-10-16: nursing-facility ownership 251,314 rows, hospital change-of-ownership 772 events + 23,857 owner rows) covers who owns the facilities behind the prices.
